chapter.heading: Romans 13
Submission to the Authorities
chapter.v: there is no authority except from God, and those that exist have been instituted by God.
Therefore whoever resists the authorities resists what God has appointed, and those who resist will incur judgment.
an avenger who carries out God's wrath on the wrongdoer.
For because of this you also pay taxes, for the authorities are ministers of God, attending to this very thing.
Pay to all what is owed to them: taxes to whom taxes are owed, revenue to whom revenue is owed, respect to whom respect is owed, honor to whom honor is owed.
the one who loves another has fulfilled the law.
“You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
love is the fulfilling of the law.
For salvation is nearer to us now than when we first believed.
put on the armor of light.
